description: Use this when the user asks when the next ship leaves for a route, or which sailings there are in a month. Returns upcoming sailings (vessel, port of loading, port of discharge, departure and arrival dates, RORO or container) from the IVSS sailing schedule, with the time the schedule was last verified. Dates are subject to confirmation at booking; if the schedule data is out of date the tool says so and gives no dates.

from.description: Where the vehicle ships from: a country (e.g. "UK", "Germany", "USA"), a region (europe, north-america, south-america, oceania ...) or a port code (e.g. GBSOU)

month.description: Optional, YYYY-MM within the next 12 months

to.description: Where it ships to: country, region or port code, e.g. "Canada", "south-america", "AUMEL"

name: get_sailings
title: Next IVSS sailings for a route (RORO and container)
